body:
TagOnline is a client-side mod tailored for servers, focusing on the core function of detecting specified online players. Accessible to both server administrators and regular players, it offers a straightforward way to check the online status of target players—administrators can efficiently verify specific players’ presence for management and communication, while ordinary players can track concerned friends to easily team up or interact. With a user-friendly interface and simple operation, no complex configurations are needed. It updates online status in real time, ensuring accurate information and providing reliable support for in-server interaction and management.~~~~(This mod is AI-generated and might have bugs or glitches)~~~~
 
# TagOnline（标记在线）
 
TagOnline是一款专为服务器打造的客户端模组，核心功能为检测服务器上指定的在线玩家。无论是服务器管理员还是普通玩家，均可便捷使用：管理员能快速确认特定玩家是否在线，以便开展管理与沟通工作；普通玩家也可追踪关注的好友，轻松实现组队或互动。模组界面友好、操作简单，无需复杂配置，且能实时更新玩家在线状态，确保信息准确无误，为服务器内的互动与管理提供可靠支持。~~~~（此模组是由AI生成的，可能包含一些错误或瑕疵）~~~~
